name: context-bar
description: Band above the prompt: stacked context-window bar by category, static prefix shaded and marked, conversation rows sorted by size, autocompact marker, legend at min/norm/max detail.

labels.title: Label level
labels.description: Legend detail: min, norm or max (norm puts System, Tool defs, MCP, Agent defs, AGENTS.md and Skills into one Static prefix row). /context-bar min|norm|max changes it for this session.

refreshGrowthPercent.title: Refresh after growth (%)
refreshGrowthPercent.description: Re-measure the shown band when the context has grown or shrunk by this share of the window since the last measure (manual /context-bar r and compaction always refresh).

trendRefreshSeconds.title: Trend redraw interval (seconds)
trendRefreshSeconds.description: How often the expanded trend graph redraws by itself while the session is idle: 15, 30 or 60.

theme.title: Colour theme
theme.description: auto follows the Claude Code theme; dark or light forces one

colors.title: Colour overrides
colors.description: JSON like {"dark":{"reads":"#64b5f6"}}; keys are categories, values #rrggbb, per theme
